<thought>We need to check whether the constructed retrosynthesis route JSON conforms to the required schema. We'll build a route where the target molecule (placeholder SMILES "TARGET") is produced by template 1914393 from two precursors. One of those precursors is further generated by template 1914394 from two simpler precursors, and one of those is generated by template 1914395 from a single precursor. We'll pass this JSON to the verify_route tool to see if it is valid.</thought>
<action>verify_route</action>

  "route": "{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"TARGET\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"reaction\",\"template_id\":1914393,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1\"},{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"reaction\",\"template_id\":1914394,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"ClCCl\"},{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"reaction\",\"template_id\":1914395,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"OCC1CCN(Cc2ccccc2)1\"}]}]}]}]}]}]}}"
